description:
Netsimco, a Saalex Company is seeking a highly motivated Web Application Developer in Keyport, WA to support the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of modern business applications. The successful candidate will leverage both traditional software development methodologies and low-code/no-code technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions that improve business operations and user experience. This position supports the full application lifecycle, including requirements gathering, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance, and end-user support.
 Position Type:  Full-Time
 Salary Range:  $90K-$120K (depending on experience)
 Work Location:  This is a remote position.
 
 Essential Functions: 
 Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain custom web applications using modern development frameworks and technologies.
 Create, enhance, and support databases and web-based solutions that meet operational and business requirements.
 Develop and maintain applications using C#, .NET Core, SQL, JavaScript, and related technologies.
 Utilize low-code/no-code platforms to automate workflows, improve business processes, and accelerate application delivery.
 Integrate applications with databases, APIs, third-party services, and enterprise systems.
 Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve application issues, performance concerns, and user-reported defects.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business needs, and propose technical solutions.
 Participate in software testing, code reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
 Maintain technical documentation, user guides, and system configuration records.
 Support application security, data integrity, and software lifecycle management processes.
 Provide end-user assistance and technical support for deployed applications.
 Work independently and collaboratively within Agile and team-based development environments.
 Other duties as assigned or required.
 Requirements 
 Required: 
 Minimum of three (3) years of experience developing, maintaining, and supporting web applications.
 Demonstrated proficiency with:
 C#
 SQL
 .NET Core
 JavaScript
 Experience designing, developing, and supporting web-based applications and relational databases.
 Experience integrating applications with APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.
 Experience utilizing low-code/no-code platforms such as:
 Microsoft Power Platform
 Power Apps
 Power Automate
 Mendix
 OutSystems
 Appian
 Or similar platforms
 Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
 Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong verbal and written communication skills.
 Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.
 
 Desired: 
 Experience with responsive web design principles and modern front-end frameworks.
 Experience using source control and development lifecycle tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
 Experience developing and deploying applications in cloud-based environments.
 Familiarity with secure software development practices and cybersecurity principles.
 Experience supporting application lifecycle management (ALM) processes.
 Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and sprint-based project execution.
 
 Education: 
 HS Diploma or GED and at least 3 years of relevant experience required.
 
 Security Clearance: 
 Active Secret clearance required. Requirements to obtain a clearance include US Citizenship, security investigation, etc.  
 
 Benefits 
 Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
 Wellness Resources
 Stock Option Plan
